name: Kairo UI
summary: Collection of 13 free MIT-licensed Next.js landing page templates installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: Free landing page templates for Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, installed into a project with a single shadcn CLI command. Templates cover SaaS, AI tools, e-commerce, agency and mobile app pages with hero, features, pricing, FAQ, testimonials and footer sections in dark and light styles.
